# Warsame

Mohamud Ali Mohamed (Awsame) is a distinguished university lecturer and seasoned professional in the fields of education and telecommunications. With a robust academic foundation and a deep commitment to public service, he has played a vital role in shaping the educational landscape in Somalia. As the former Gedo Regional Education Supervisor, he was instrumental in elevating educational standards and implementing strategic reforms across the region.
Currently, Mr. Awsame serves as the Senior Marketing Specialist at Hormuud Telecom, one of Somalia's leading telecommunications companies. In this role, he leads high-impact marketing strategies, drives customer engagement, and spearheads initiatives aimed at enhancing brand recognition and service innovation.
Belonging to the Reer Cismaan sub-clan of the Mareexaan, Mohamud Ali Mohamed is deeply rooted in his community and continues to advocate for development through both his professional and academic endeavors. His career reflects a unique blend of technical expertise, leadership, and a passion for education-driven progress.
